\documentclass[border=8pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}

\begin{tikzpicture}[line width=1pt]
  \draw[gray!30] (-.3,-2.4) rectangle (4.4,9.5);
  \draw[-{To[scale=2]}] (0,9)--(4,9);
  \draw[-{To[reversed,scale=2]}] (0,8)--(4,8);
  \draw[-{To[harpoon,scale=2]}] (0,7)--(4,7);
  \draw[-{To[harpoon,reversed,scale=2]}] (0,6)--(4,6);
  \draw[-{To[harpoon,swap,scale=2]}] (0,5)--(4,5);
  \draw[-{To[sharp,length=10pt,width=12pt,line width=.7pt]}] (0,4)--(4,4);
  \draw[-{To[sharp,harpoon,length=10pt,width=12pt]}] (0,3)--(4,3);
  \draw[-{To[slant=.5,scale length=2,scale width=.8]}] (0,2)--(4,2);
  \draw[-{To[length=8pt,width'=0pt 1.5,line width'=0pt .08]}] (0,1)--(4,1);
  \draw[-{to[reversed]}] (0,0)--(4,0);
